$comment: Single source of truth for secret-scanner version support. The scanner-compat workflow reads `repo`/`asset`/`floor` to build its live N-3 + floor matrix, and `scripts/sync-secrets-docs.ts` injects `floor`/`note` into the compatibility matrix in docs/docs/configuration/secrets.md. Move a floor here and both stay correct. A floor only moves FORWARD, and only when a scanner's CLI/output changes in a way the adapter cannot bridge.

gitleaks.note: 8.19.0–8.19.2 ship the `stdin` command but reject our report flags; 8.18.x has no `stdin` command at all.

betterleaks.note: Shares gitleaks' `stdin -f json` interface and report shape.

trufflehog.note: Older releases use the same `filesystem --json` interface; line numbers are absent before later 3.6x builds, which only affects the (advisory) reported line.

detect-secrets.note: The `scan` baseline JSON shape has been stable across 1.2–1.5.
